caption: The video showcases a stationary view of a warehouse roller-conveyor system. A metal roller line runs diagonally from the near left toward the far right, while a blue curved conveyor sits to the left. A green plastic bin slides into frame from the left edge and travels rightward along the foreground rollers. It grows large as it passes close to the camera, then shrinks as it recedes into the distance. A small cardboard box sits on the parallel background line at the upper right, showing only modest apparent shifts. After the bin moves toward the far end, a cardboard box enters the foreground left and follows the same rightward path. It advances along the rollers toward the upper right. A second box bearing a bold black logo then appears at the left edge and continues this motion, still traveling in the final frame. The black segmented guide elements along the right edge of the conveyor shift position from frame to frame. The background posts, railings and blue curved conveyor remain fixed in the frame, confirming the camera holds its vantage point throughout the excerpt.
